config.mxt.server.formation.plate_auto_d: An unbound plate scans the formations its allow list admits, compares structures, raises the nearest match and names it. Off requires /mxt formation bind first.
config.mxt.server.formation.empty_plate_: What an empty allow list means: on permits any formation, off requires every plate to list what it may run.
config.mxt.server.formation.draws_enviro: The ambient aura of the ground also pays a formation's upkeep; off uses only what the formation's own blocks supply.
config.mxt.server.formation.respect_frie: Whether a formation that declares spare_friends spares the owner's friends, the owner included, FTB Teams members and allies included. Off makes such formations affect everyone.
config.mxt.server.formation.teammates_ca: Let the owner's friends, FTB Teams members and allies included, take the formation down; off leaves it to the owner and operators, and an entity nobody can identify is refused either way. Off by default.
